name: meteor-blaze
description: Use when building or debugging Meteor 3 Blaze interfaces: meteor create --blaze, Spacebars, helpers/events, lifecycle, Tracker, ReactiveVar/ReactiveDict, subscriptions, Promise helpers, #let states, Template.dynamic, Blaze.render, and blaze-hot HMR. Triggers on stale async results, lost reactivity after await, data-context lookup surprises, duplicate DOM integrations, Rspack full reloads, raw HTML in triple braces, jQuery not found, Expected template or null, Template.instance() is null after await, missing event.dataTransfer, Reactive HTML attributes, BLOCKOPEN, TRIPLE template tag, Expected "li" end tag, or Template can't be named. Use this skill when asked about reusable Blaze components, the Blaze PWA scaffold, package/backend selection, Rspack entry imports, or template tests. For Meteor 2 to 3 upgrades, use migrate-to-meteor-3; for unexplained cross-layer failures, meteor-debugging.
